title: A Survey on Large Language Models with some Insights on their Capabilities and Limitations
explain_beginner: This paper surveys large language models, the AI systems behind tools like ChatGPT. Researchers examined how these models work, why they perform so well at language tasks, and discovered interesting abilities they develop beyond their original training, such as reasoning and coding. The paper explains how feeding more data and computing power improves performance, explores real-world uses in medicine and law, and investigates where thinking abilities come from in their training data rather than treating these skills as mysterious.
explain_business: This research demonstrates that LLMs provide substantial value across healthcare, finance, education, and legal sectors with domain-specific applications. However, organizations must understand that capability improvements require careful investment in data and computing resources, with associated trade-offs to evaluate. The paper emphasizes that reasoning abilities depend on training data composition, suggesting data quality matters for deployment. By connecting performance to measurable factors rather than treating improvements as unpredictable, the survey helps executives make informed decisions about LLM adoption, investment levels, and risk management in increasingly complex operational environments.
explain_practitioner: This survey examines transformer-based LLMs, analyzing scaling laws showing how data and computational investment drive performance improvements across language tasks. The authors investigated emergent capabilities including commonsense reasoning and code generation, with particular focus on Chain-of-Thought and Plan-of-Thought mechanisms. They traced these reasoning behaviors to pre-training data patterns rather than treating emergence as unexplained. The work evaluates LLM-modulo frameworks integrating external systems for complex tasks and assesses architectural strategies, scaling trade-offs, and generalization mechanisms across diverse applications.
